summary: DevvStream Corp. filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, announcing the postponement of its special shareholder meeting from September 10 to September 17, 2026, to complete preparations for a proposed three-way business combination with XCF Global Inc. and Southern Energy Renewables Inc. under a Business Combination Agreement dated April 13, 2026. A definitive joint proxy statement/prospectus dated July 31, 2026, with a July 29 record date, was mailed to shareholders. No financial terms or board recommendation were disclosed in this excerpt. The delay signals ongoing vote preparation; watch for revised closing timeline and any shareholder redemption or approval risk.
